description: Registers of waste placement permits issued in Kyrgyzstan is a series of data sets listed in data.gov.kg, an open data portal, published or maintained by Ministry of Natural Resources, Ecology and Technical Supervision of Kyrgyzstan. Coverage: Kyrgyzstan. The portal lists 3 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. Its title on the portal is "Реестры по выданным разрешениям на размещение отходов в окружающую среду за 2025 год" (Russian). The portal files it under the publisher Ministry of Natural Resources, Ecology and Technical Supervision of Kyrgyzstan. Its tags are 2025 год, отходы в окружающую среду, разрешения, реестр, экология. It offers 7 resource(s) in DOCX. The portal shows 2025-05-28 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support waste-facility and collection planning. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-kg-portal.
